capabilities: Convert a note's headings and optional list items into an interactive mindmap
Add, rename, delete and drag nodes on the map with two-way write-back to the note
Locate and highlight the matching heading or list item in a visible note
Customize node shapes, colors, fonts, spacing and branch direction globally or per note
Export the map to PNG, SVG or PDF
extras: Not yet in the community plugin browser, so it must be installed manually from GitHub Releases. The README documents known limitations (text-only maps, no images or free-form connections, collapsed state not persisted) and includes a 1000-node stress note plus self-check tools.
problem: Obsidian has no way to see or restructure a note's outline as a visual mindmap where edits on the map write back into the note.
summary: Renders a Markdown note's heading/list outline as an interactive mindmap with two-way editing, click-to-locate navigation and style options.
